retrievalProfile.description: A fusion of traditional western cowboy aesthetics with urban street art, featuring large-scale graffiti lettering on a textured wall behind subjects.
excludeWhen: traditional rural landscape photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: Two male figures in western attire posed against a textured, sun-bleached wall featuring massive, stylized graffiti lettering and a longhorn skull motif.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects positioned in the lower half to allow typography to dominate the upper frame
Sepia-toned color palette unifying the subjects with the background
Contrast between the rough, gritty ground and the bold, graphic wall art
Integration of musical instruments and western accessories to establish genre
coreInvariants: Stylized longhorn skull integrated into the central typography
High-contrast black outlines on the background graffiti

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects in the lower third; one seated on a crate, one leaning against the wall, scaled to appear smaller than the background text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, black-outlined graffiti text spanning the top two-thirds of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top text, moves down to the subjects, and settles on the secondary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture, subjects, and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sepia tones for the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the graffiti outlines and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white for the fill of the graffiti and the secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the black outlines and the light wall.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: Interlocking characters with varying baseline heights
Integration of illustrative elements like a longhorn skull into the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized as a fluid, calligraphic stroke

composition.relationshipToImage: painted directly onto the background wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, structured graffiti paired with a loose, informal marker-style script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, interlocking decorative nature of the main text.
Captures the urban street art influence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of two men in western hats and shirts leaning against a sun-bleached, textured concrete wall in a dusty, sepia-toned environment with a guitar on the ground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, black-outlined graffiti lettering in a blackletter style to the upper wall area, integrating a longhorn skull into the center. Add a smaller, white hand-drawn script at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the graffiti integrated into the wall texture?
Is the sepia tone consistent across subjects and background?
Does the longhorn skull feel part of the typography?
Is the hierarchy clear between the two text elements?

mustRedesign: Ensure the longhorn skull is a generic illustration
Create unique letterforms that do not match specific commercial fonts
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless integration of text and wall texture
Verify the sepia palette is not overly orange or green
Ensure the subjects' clothing matches the western theme
Confirm the graffiti outlines are bold and consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Western Subject + Urban Graffiti Backdrop + Sepia Toning + High-Contrast Outlined Typography
